features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Kyocera KJ4B Single-Pass Printhead System
items.desc: Industrial Kyocera KJ4B series inkjet heads arranged in a fixed single-pass configuration deliver continuous, non-stop printing at up to 120 metres per minute across the full print width.

items.title: In-Line Pre-Treatment System
items.desc: Built-in chemical pre-treatment is applied directly on the machine before printing, eliminating the need for offline processing and saving time, water, and production floor space.

items.title: SPR Same Print Result Technology
items.desc: Guarantees identical colour output across multiple machines and repeat production runs, making the LaRIO the benchmark choice for scalable manufacturing with consistent buyer-facing quality.

items.title: Wi-Fi Remote Operation via iPad
items.desc: Real-time machine control, job monitoring, and production alerts are managed wirelessly from an iPad, reducing operator setup time and enabling on-the-go production oversight.

items.title: Anti-Crash Head Safety System
items.desc: Automatic substrate thickness detection and independent colour-bar safety stops protect all printheads from contact with uneven fabric surfaces or obstructions during high-speed operation.

items.title: High-Precision Belt Control System
items.desc: Steel foil combined with an electronic tension control system maintains substrate stability and print sharpness at ultra-high speeds, preventing fabric shift or stretch during single-pass printing.

items.title: Non-Stop Jumbo Roll Winder
items.desc: Automatic roll collection enables uninterrupted production across 24/7 operating schedules without manual intervention at the winding stage between production runs.

items.title: Automatic Capping and Wiping System
items.desc: Automated printhead capping and wiping maintains nozzle condition and enables clean, immediate restart after scheduled maintenance stops or planned production breaks.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Mass-Volume Fashion Textile Production
fabrics.desc: The world's fastest single-pass digital textile printer for large polyester and blended fabric manufacturers supplying wholesale saree, dress material, and fashion textile markets at maximum possible daily output.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Export Garment Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Continuous reactive printing on cotton for major export facilities supplying international fashion brands, where per-metre cost efficiency and consistent colour across large repeat orders are critical.

fabrics.title: Wide-Format Home Textile and Furnishing Production
fabrics.desc: 3200 mm configuration handles extra-wide bedding, curtain fabric, upholstery, and large-format furnishing textiles, removing width constraints that limit narrower single-pass machines.

fabrics.title: Integrated Mills and Vertically Integrated Manufacturers
fabrics.desc: Manufacturers operating dedicated digital printing divisions within vertically integrated facilities who need single-pass output volumes that match weaving and finishing line capacities.

fabrics.title: Multi-Machine Scalable Operations
fabrics.desc: SPR Same Print Result technology makes the LaRIO the only choice for production operations running multiple machines simultaneously, where colour consistency across machines is a non-negotiable requirement.

fabrics.title: Flag, Banner, and Wide-Format Soft Signage
fabrics.desc: 3200 mm print width and single-pass speed make the LaRIO equally suited to large-format flags, exhibition banners, retail soft signage, and event textile production at industrial volumes.

fabrics.title: 24/7 Round-the-Clock Production Facilities
fabrics.desc: Non-stop jumbo roll winding, Wi-Fi remote monitoring, and automated maintenance systems are designed specifically for facilities running continuous multi-shift production schedules.
